classes.label: Video
classes.comment: A YouTube video record from the ecosystem search endpoint.

classes.label: Video Observation
classes.comment: Snapshot of mutable video and channel metrics at observation time.

classes.label: Blogger
classes.comment: YouTube channel or blogger that published the video.

classes.label: Institution
classes.comment: An institution referenced in the video record.

classes.label: Strategic Tag

classes.label: Core Ideology

approval.rationale: Mappings were checked against a real AI Index YouTube response. The template preserves video introduction, transcript excerpt, publisher, cover URL, engagement counters, blogger introduction, fans_num, core ideology conclusions and theory. Source identity and normalized publication time are supplied by the common base projection, avoiding duplicate publishedAt values.
